model_inspection.findings: Continuous torsos and grounded leg arrangements are useful provisional construction. Its engraved short-coat marks are not anatomical authority or finish precedent; current finished images replace them with broad close-coat planes.

staging_inspection.findings: Two drawn café/snack panels inspected. Lower panel establishes paw-on-paw stop on stool with three other limbs grounded per dog. Final snack image retains connected shoulder-to-paw construction and contact. Top panel establishes table occlusion and messy-versus-clean facial contrast.

findings: Neet has a full narrow tan torso, fine legs, visible neck, broad triangular ears and a tiny nub; the upward gaze and open mouth communicate alarm without changing the adult head shape.

Buddy has a continuous moderately elongated charcoal trunk, substantial legs and clear floor clearance. Four feet per dog are traceable; overlapping far legs remain attached to their own bodies. Paws and contact shadows sit coherently on the same landing.

Buddy retains pale muzzle and brows, pendant furnished ears, dark throat and tan chest sides. Both torsos use broad close-coat planes; faint surface grain is not curled strands or shag volume. Facial and distal furnishings remain regional.

Two carved guardians, white-marble steps, floral relief and peacock motif support the described temple. Neet addresses the nearer lion while Buddy watches calmly. The picture sits after the alarm line and before the second-lion check; lowered paws are a plausible instant after the earlier pointing gesture.
Architecture recedes consistently and the dogs remain foreground-scale coherent. No clipped limb, stray mark, illegible lettering or material finish defect found.

Neet retains broad cupped ears, projecting muzzle, smooth tan face and pale flush throat. Dal on the nose and mango on chin/chest make his self-satisfied expression funny at the precise pre-wiping story state.

Buddy’s head joins a visible neck and upper chest; dark central throat separates the pale beard from tan chest fields. Ear, brow and muzzle strands are localized, while shoulder surfaces remain close and smooth. No actual curled short-coat strands or enlarged torso shag found.
The tabletop deliberately occludes lower bodies and all paws. There are no detached limbs; the bench behind supports the seated premise without inventing visible leg geometry.

Clean Buddy looks toward messy Neet; torn roti is kept separately to Buddy’s side. Thali bowls, dhokla, samosa and chaas make the food setting legible. The image precedes the spice reaction and does not prematurely show wiping or snack-box action.
Warm café interior, table perspective and plate/bowl contact are coherent. No material identity, scene or finish defect found.

Each dog has exactly one raised forelimb and three floor-supported limbs: one grounded foreleg and two hindlegs. Neet’s reaching limb runs continuously from the near shoulder through elbow to tan paw; Buddy’s near shoulder leads into a bent forelimb and pale paw above it. The grounded far forelegs are distinct from the raised limbs.

Buddy’s pale paw visibly overlaps Neet’s tan paw at the left part of the stool top. The hands are not separate across the stool or attached to the other dog’s shoulder. The contact reads as a gentle stop before jalebi, with stool support and stable rear-leg placement.

Neet retains full slender torso, fine legs, broad ears and nub. Buddy retains connected long trunk, neck, substantial legs, belly clearance and a tapering dark tail. Perspective and relative scales are consistent across the floor.

Smooth close-coat color planes retain the corrected finish throughout both bodies. Buddy’s muzzle, eyebrows, ears and slight distal furnishing remain regional; there are no engraved curls or raised body shag. Heather’s rear-view appearance remains provisional.

Open orange jalebi box rests on the low stool and Heather faces the payment counter. Neet is clean after the preceding wipe. Opposed gazes and the shared paw contact communicate Buddy’s decision to protect their snacks; no premature fafda reward appears.
No disconnected anatomy, extra limb, floating contact, material texture regression or scene contradiction found.
